Start date: 1897-09-22  
Subtract 24 weeks = 168 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 173 days.  
1897 is not a leap year (not divisible by 400, not divisible by 4? 1897 ÷ 4 = 474.25 → not leap).  
Count back:  
September has 30 days. From Sep 22 go back 22 days → Aug 31.  
Remaining days: 173 − 22 = 151 days to subtract further.  
August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (non-leap), January 31.  
Back from Aug 31:  
Aug: 31 days → July 31 (subtract 31) → 151 − 31 = 120 left.  
July: 31 days → June 30 (subtract 31) → 120 − 31 = 89 left.  
June: 30 days → May 31 (subtract 30) → 89 − 30 = 59 left.  
May: 31 days → April 30 (subtract 31) → 59 − 31 = 28 left.  
April: 30 days → March 31 (subtract 28 days of April) → 0 left, so date is April 2 (since April 30 − 28 days = April 2).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1897-04-02
